review.method_name: Single-sideband envelope detection with Kramers-Kronig SSBI mitigation for THz-over-fibre transmission
experimental_conditions: 5 GBd 16-QAM THz-over-fibre transmission with a 10 km single-mode-fiber link
250 GHz THz carrier and 0.3 m wireless distance using horn antennas
Combined optical linewidths from 22 kHz to 905 kHz were evaluated
main_results: For total optical linewidths wider than 0.55 MHz, the single-sideband approach provided better sensitivity than baseband carrier recovery
Without KK processing, meeting the FEC target required a 39% reduction in spectral density
With the KK receiver, a 2.95 b/s/Hz information spectral density met the FEC target, only 15% below the upper limit
